registered: 2026-10-15, before running; first use of the reserved data (signal weeks from 2025-07-01)
run: local, PYTHONPATH=. python3 work/v3w/forward_exam1.py (exploratory scripts in work/v3w are not in the repo; sha256 prefixes below)
shapes: draft 1.5: 1.4 C bottom golden cross (flat bottoms <= +10%, fresh cross after >= 4 weeks under DEA, decline <= 60%, span <= 90 weeks, swing targets) with DIF < 0 at the signal week
universe: universe-1985-v1 + fresh-a..d-1995-v1 (~6,700 US stocks, ETFs removed), data to 2026-10-09 / 2026-10-12
ranking: taste model v1 (research/lab/cases/taste-model-v1.json): L2 logistic regression on 24 pre-signal features, trained once on the user's 130 blind judgements
trade_rule: 1.6: limit 2% under the signal close, alive 8 weeks, cancelled if the stop or target trades first; stop 1% under the last bottom and at least 0.5 weekly ATR under the entry; target = nearest swing high -3% at least 7% over the signal close, all sold; skip if planned R:R < 1.5; 13-week time stop
counted: signals whose 105 sessions after the signal are inside the data; later ones are listed as open
baselines: 30 same-day random stocks per trade with the same mechanics; SPY over the same holding days
averages: R capped at +5 on both sides
pass: taste group (p >= 0.5): >= 30 trades, mean R > 0, mean R minus random mean R > 0 with month-clustered t >= 2.0
reading: pass -> propose weekly paper trading with this setup (needs the user's approval); not passed but taste group better than p < 0.5 -> keep collecting forward (paper) trades; otherwise rethink the shape and ranking
